exposure: Pulmonary arterial hypertension associated with congenital heart disease (PAH-CHD)
cohort: 260 pregnant women with PAH-CHD admitted to the Beijing Anzhen Hospital from 2010 to 2019
finding: While most pregnant women with PAH-CHD successfully gave birth, PAH-CHD was found to increase both maternal and fetal risk.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery was performed in 88.1% of the patients, with 15.0% being emergency cesareans.
birth_weight: Low birth weight was observed in 33.8% of the offspring.
